description.narrative:
Action for Development Organization (AFD) has proposed to work in Kampong Thom province. The project will work closely with 8 Community Forestries (CF) and 1 Community Protected Area (CPA) which aim to better conserved through increased community uptake of alternative livelihoods, community led protection and using the innovative application to measure CO2 absorbed by their forest. The project interventions are expected to benefit directly to 850 (50% is females) community forestry members and indirectlyto 8,758 people oftargeted villages who is 40% of them is females. The goal of the project is that “Reduced carbon emissions from agroforestry exploitation in 8 CFs and 1 CPA in Kampong Thom Province through the promotion of sustainable and alternativelivelihoods.”
To accomplish the goal, the project is expected to achieve 2 objectives: • Eight Community Forestry (CF) and one Community Protected Area (CPA) are better conserved through increased community uptake of alternative livelihoods, community led protection and using the innovative application to measure CO2 absorbed by their forest management plan. • Increased public and private investment for climate change related interventions policies and commitments through subnational dialogue/workshopwith existing mechanism and produce evident base.
To meet the two objectives, project will cooperate with national, and subnational government and local authorities for the project implementation which including coordination and technical support.

participating-org.narrative: Action For Development (AFD) is a non-profit organization. It is a local NGOs that focus on livelihood, good government, natural resource and environment management. AFD established in 2004, and registered with Ministry of Interior in 2006. AFD and Oxfamhave worked in partnership since 2008 for development program in natural resource management and livelihood sector. AFD has mission to work in partnership to secure rights of natural resource dependent communities, increasing influence over democratic decision making ensuring suitable natural resource management supports diversity conservation and climate change adaptation by raising income and food security to alleviate poverty. It has vision #AFD believes that all people are equal to live their lives with dignity and respectfullyparticipating in transparent and accountable rural development decisions that alleviate poverty and suffering and protect Cambodia#s rich diversity.# AFD has experienced in emergency response in Kampong Thom with Oxfam in 2009and 2011, recovery in 2012. AFD support Oxfam implementing emergency response. It followed the design of emergency response working as joint activities to release humanitarian assistance.
